changelog:
⚡ What's New & Fixed in v1.6.9:

• 🌙 30s Smart Background Auto-Standby: When running in the background or minimized, JARVIS automatically returns to silent offline standby 30 seconds after completing a reply, giving you plenty of time for follow-up questions while preventing unwanted listening to ambient room speech.

• 🔇 Rock-Solid Steady Mic: Completely eliminated microphone toggling/blinking (ON/OFF cycling) in background standby mode. Direct in-memory continuous Vosk Kaldi AI keeps the hardware microphone smoothly active without privacy light flickering.

• 🎯 Precision Wake Word Filtering: Fixed false wakeups on ambient greetings like 'hello'. Jarvis now strictly triggers on full wake phrases ('Hey Jarvis', 'Hello Jarvis', 'Jarvis') and ignores general conversation.

• 🛡️ ProGuard R8 Native Protection: Added keep rules for Vosk and JNA native shared libraries for rock-solid release build stability.

• ⚡ Instant Voice Response: Optimized pre-connection audio buffering for zero dropped syllables upon wake.
